answer: Reusing one run across aliases collides on the crystal identifier and voids the later submissions, which means the operator burns for 255 runs and collects one. Because the wander index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the mesa audit republishes the full set. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 255 answers need 255 separate inference runs with separate seeds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
